counterfactual_missing_items: description of tumor markers or molecular characteristics
decisive_items: polygonal to short spindle-shaped cells formed small nests and sheets within dilated sinusoids without encapsulation
The tumor cells exhibited clear cell borders, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, frequent mitotic figures, and sparse hepatocellular necrosis
response.rationale: R3 is the strongest candidate due to its detailed histological description consistent with hepatocellular carcinoma, including high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, and frequent mitotic figures. R2, while suggesting a neoplastic process, lacks the specific histological details that make R3 a more definitive diagnosis.

rejected.why: C1 is an append-only completion of R3, adding subtype information but not standing alone as a distinct diagnosis.
